resources.string: A pop-up dictionary for Yomitan dictionaries. Select a text in any app and choose "SubRead Dictionary" in the menu, share a text to it, or send a word from SubRead Overlay. The pop-up shows each term at the start of the text, the longest first, with the reading, the pitch accent, the frequency and the audio.
Nothing leaves the device, except when a remote audio source is on: then the word goes to that server.
Yomitan dictionaries, as .zip files: JMdict, Jitendex, a pitch accent dictionary, a frequency list. The order here is the order in the pop-up.
A dictionary with this title is already imported. Delete it first.
This dictionary has format %1$d. The app reads format 3.
The android.db of the Local Audio Server for Yomitan, the same file that AnkiConnect Android and Hoshi Reader use. Choose the file; the app copies it. Or push it with adb to the folder below.
Order of the sources, comma separated

One URL per line. {term} and {reading} are replaced. A URL can give an audio file, or the JSON list of a Local Audio Server on the network (http://192.168.1.2:5050/?term={term}&reading={reading}). Used after the local audio.
No term found. Tap a character to look up from there.
No dictionary is enabled. Open the app to import one.
